description: Fetch the full review report of a submitted software: pass/fail, rejection reasons and structured findings to fix. Heavier than check_review_status — call this only after the review pipeline has completed, not for live progress polling. Findings are capped at 10 locations each (a CVE finding can carry hundreds of near-identical ones); the response then sets truncated:true and locations_omitted per finding. Raise max_locations_per_finding when you actually need the long tail. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

max_locations_per_finding.description: How many locations to keep per finding, default 10

name: get_review_report
title: Get Crela review report
